message.content:
Based on the provided mobile screenshot (390px wide viewport), here are the precise answers to your questions:

**1) List every section visible from top to bottom:**
*   **Header:** Contains the "TopBid.UZ" logo, "O'rin olish" (Take a place) orange button, and a hamburger menu icon.
*   **Sub-header/Tagline:** A light beige pill with text about finding tutors and centers.
*   **Hero Section:** Large bold headline ("O'zingizga mos repetitor..."), descriptive paragraph, and a primary CTA button ("Reytingga qo'shilish").
*   **Stats Panel:** A 2x2 grid of statistics (Online users, Views, Income, Profiles).
*   **Promo Banner:** An orange card with discount details, a countdown timer, and a black CTA button.
*   **Tab Bar:** A segmented control with "O'rganish" (Study) and "Yollash" (Hire) options.
*   **Section Label:** Text indicating this is the rating for tutors, centers, and courses.
*   **Filter Pills (Row 1):** Horizontal scrollable list starting with "Barchasi", "Markaz", "Repetitor".
*   **Filter Pills (Row 2):** Partially visible row starting with "Yo'nalish: barchasi".

**2) Are any RANKING CARDS visible?**
No. The screenshot ends at the filter pills section. The actual list of ranking cards (with rank numbers, avatars, names, and prices) is not yet visible.

**3) What is visible at the very BOTTOM edge of the screenshot?**
The very bottom edge shows the top portion of a second row of filter dropdowns/pills. Specifically, the text **"Yo'nalish: barchasi"** (Direction: all) and **"Shahar: barchasi"** (City: all) are partially cut off at the bottom. The content is definitely truncated here.

**4) Describe the dark circular button with letter 'N':**
*   **Position:** It is located in the **bottom-left corner** of the screen, overlapping the left edge of the first filter pill ("Barchasi").
*   **Approximate Size:** It appears to be roughly **50-60px in diameter** (relative to the 390px width).
*   **Overlap:** Yes, it **OVERLAPS** and covers the left side of the **"Barchasi"** (All) filter pill, obscuring the icon and the beginning of the word.

**5) In the orange banner: countdown values and clipping:**
*   **Countdown Values & Units:**
    *   **13 KUN** (Days)
    *   **04 SOAT** (Hours)
    *   **37 DAQ** (Minutes)
    *   **32 SEK** (Seconds)
*   **Clipping/Wrapping:** No, the text in the banner is fully visible and wrapped normally. There is no awkward clipping.

**6) Are the filter pills at the bottom ('Barchasi', 'Markaz', 'Repetitor') fully visible?**
The pills themselves are mostly visible, but they are **not fully readable** because the dark circular 'N' button overlaps the leftmost pill ("Barchasi"), covering its icon and the start of the text. The other pills ("Markaz", "Repetitor") are fully visible.

**7) Estimate pixel height of header 'O'rin olish' button:**
The height of the orange "O'rin olish" button is approximately **44-50 CSS pixels** (or roughly 130-150 physical pixels).

**8) Any element touching the left/right screen edges?**
Yes:
*   **Left Edge:** The circular 'N' button touches/overlaps the left edge. Also, the main content container has padding, but the background elements or specific UI components like the banner might visually approach the edge (though standard padding usually applies). However, the **'N' button** is the most prominent element breaking the boundary on the left.
*   **Right Edge:** The hamburger menu icon (three lines) in the header is aligned to the right edge (with standard padding).

**9) Is the stats panel 2x2 or 1x4? Readability?**
It is a **2x2 grid** (2 columns, 2 rows). All 4 stat labels ("Hozir onlayn", "Jami tashrif", "Jami daromad", "Profillar") are **fully readable**.

**10) Any text overlapping other text anywhere?**
No, there is no instance of text overlapping other text within the layout itself. The only overlap involves the graphical **'N' button** covering text, but text-on-text collision does not occur.
